envelope.description: Pending-row writes keep and count every relationship

body.title: Pending-row writes keep and count every relationship
body.summary: In src/db/relations.ts: upsertResolvedRelations keeps a code-symbol relation with an absent target as one pending row keyed makeUnresolvedRelationId(repo, from, kind, awaitedId), meta {awaitsId, class 'awaiting-target', reason 'target-not-stored-yet', absolute file, repo} (a boundary kind with class 'external-endpoint'), indexed in unresolved_by_target; a missing source or unknown kind is counted unwritable against meta.repo or the unattributed counter and logged at warn. upsertUnresolvedRelations counts every row by class and indexes awaitsId rows; a dropped row is counted with its reason. promoteToResolved / promoteResolvedBatch re-key a row kept awaiting (old row and index entries removed, new written, counts moved, absolute meta.file kept), advance the generation, and return { promoted, keptAwaiting, unwritable }. Anchors (today's behaviour): upsertResolvedRelations (src/db/relations.ts:120) skips a relation whose endpoint is not stored (:135-138) or whose kind has no byte (:139-143) with only a debug count (:148-153); upsertUnresolvedRelations (:211) drops rows at :223-229 and :253-263; promoteToResolved (:385-405) and promoteResolvedBatch (:422-440) delete the pending row even when the edge is skipped (:397-403, :433-437). Depends on t2 for the in-transaction count helpers.
acceptanceChecks: Every input of upsertResolvedRelations ends as an edge, one pending row awaiting the target, or a counted unwritable; none is dropped
Writing the same relationship twice while its target is absent leaves one row and an awaiting count of 1

promoteResolvedBatch's returned { promoted, keptAwaiting, unwritable } is checked directly in src/db/__tests__/relations-awaiting-target.test.ts and relations-lmdb.test.ts (which already calls it, :322-366); promoteResolvedBatch has three production callers (src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts:335, src/indexer/external-endpoints.ts:142, src/indexer/messaging-endpoints.ts:141), all of which ignore the value; the endpoint suites (external-endpoints.test.ts, messaging-endpoints.test.ts) and the cross-file suites are regression coverage for them. promoteToResolved has no production caller (only relations-lmdb.test.ts:255), and its test is updated with it
A boundary relation with an absent target is kept as 'external-endpoint' and does not count against graphComplete

tests.name: src/db/__tests__/relations-awaiting-target.test.ts: edge / keep-awaiting / unwritable per input, one row per relationship, boundary kind kept as external-endpoint, promotions re-key and return counts
src/indexer/__tests__/external-endpoints.test.ts and messaging-endpoints.test.ts pass with the new promoteResolvedBatch return
